Bundled browser libraries
=========================

These files are hosted locally so the Utilune free image tools do not load code
from a CDN at runtime.

pica
- Version: 9.0.1
- File: pica.min.js
- Project: https://github.com/nodeca/pica
- License: MIT

UPNG.js
- Version: 2.1.0
- File: upng.min.js
- Project: https://github.com/photopea/UPNG.js
- License: MIT
- Runtime dependency: pako.min.js

pako
- Version: 2.1.0
- File: pako.min.js
- Project: https://github.com/nodeca/pako
- License: MIT

JSZip
- Version: 3.10.1
- File: jszip.min.js
- Project: https://github.com/Stuk/jszip
- License: MIT or GPL-3.0-or-later
